source_snapshot.items: NVQual - PCIE AER Error Check Test
source_snapshot.procedure: Check PCIe AER errors for all attached endpoints.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Endpoint/severity/counter/delta oracle absent; source says clear logs.

old_problem: No endpoint coverage, AER sources/severity/delta acceptance; clearing logs would destroy evidence and Criteria are unrelated.
disposition_reason: The source purpose is read-only AER inspection, not injection. Endpoint map and zero/allowed-delta policy are runtime inputs; ED-17 requires preserving existing logs.
decision_basis: Preserved all attached endpoints while rejecting evidence clearing.
No AER query or injection occurred.

test_case.test_name: Read-only all-endpoint PCIe AER delta check
test_case.purpose: Inspect every mapped PCIe endpoint/path and determine new AER deltas by severity without clearing historical evidence.
test_case.test_command: Preserve existing logs; capture timestamped baseline counters/log positions; run read-only AER check; collect post counters/log slices and compute per-path/severity deltas.
test_case.expected_result: Every required endpoint is observed and new deltas meet the signed policy with complete correlation.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Readable output/FW, cleared logs or aggregate-only count cannot PASS.
test_case.recovery: None beyond preserving evidence; stop if module mutates link/state.

source_conflict.reason: AER delta policy controls; readability/FW auxiliary and log clearing rejected.
